//: THE Ctrl+Shift+B TASK. Everything below it exists to make this one work
or to be run on its own.
`npm run dev` runs the API (:8002) and the site (:5176) in parallel, off
the sibling apps' ports, so all of them can run at once. The site proxies
/api to the backend. There is no database to start or migrate.
tasks.label: Start site (backend + frontend)
tasks.detail: Bound to Ctrl+Shift+B. Runs the API on :8002 and the site on http://localhost:5176. Checks for uv and installs first.

//: The backend half of `npm run dev` is `uv run`; without uv it would fail
quietly while the site comes up and every exhibit's figures answer 502.
tasks.label: Preflight: uv
tasks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null || { echo ''; echo '  uv is missing — the backend runs through it.'; echo '  Install: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/'; echo ''; exit 1; }; echo 'preflight ok: uv found'
tasks.detail: Fails with a readable message when uv is missing, instead of letting uvicorn fail obscurely.

//: `npm ci`, not `npm install`, and only when the lockfile is newer than the
last install: `npm install` may move any ^-ranged dependency and rewrite
the lockfile on every start, putting development on a set CI never
checked. npm writes node_modules/.package-lock.json at the end of an
install, so the two timestamps say whether the lockfile changed since.
Then `uv sync`, which does nothing when the backend's venv already
matches uv.lock.
Use 'Install dependencies (may update the lockfile)' when you mean to add
or bump something.
tasks.label: Install dependencies
tasks.command: if [ ! -e node_modules/.package-lock.json ] || [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules/.package-lock.json ]; then echo 'lockfile changed — running npm ci'; npm ci; else echo 'npm dependencies up to date'; fi && (cd backend && uv sync --frozen)
tasks.detail: npm ci at the root when the lockfile changed, then uv sync --frozen in backend/.

tasks.label: Install dependencies (may update the lockfile)
tasks.detail: For when you mean to add or bump a dependency. Rewrites package-lock.json.

tasks.label: Check everything (what CI runs)
tasks.detail: The five check:* stages — versioning, security, deadcode, frontend, backend — as the pre-push hook runs them. Bound to the default test task.
